title: Direct Acceleration of Stochastic Root-Finding Without Variance Reduction and Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2608.12043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Acceleration for deterministic root-finding problems has been extensively studied in recent years; specifically, the anchor-based, or Halpern-type methods achieve optimal convergence rates with respect to the operator norm. However, acceleration via these methods does not directly carry over to stochastic setting due to accumulation of errors, unless one enforces diminishing variance via increasing batch sizes or variance reduction techniques. In this work, we show that another class of acceleration, namely the dual-anchor mechanism, extends to the stochastic setting without such error accumulation, in contrast to anchor-based algorithms. Consequently, we cleanly achieve $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ complexity with iteration-independent batch size, without any variance reduction or double-loop recursive regularization, for stochastic root-finding (resp. fixed-point) problems with cocoercivity (resp. square-nonexpansivity) in expectation. translated_title: 随机根求解的直接加速：无需方差缩减与正则化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12043v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：近年来，确定性根求解问题的加速方法得到了广泛研究；具体而言，基于锚点或Halpern型方法在算子范数下达到了最优收敛速率。然而，由于误差累积，这些方法无法直接推广到随机设置中，除非通过增大批大小或方差缩减技术来强制减少方差。在本工作中，我们展示了另一类加速机制，即双锚机制，能够推广到随机设置而无需此类误差累积，这与基于锚点的算法形成对比。因此，我们干净地实现了$O(\epsilon^{-3})$复杂度，且批大小与迭代无关，无需任何方差缩减或双循环递归正则化，适用于具有期望余强单调性（或平方非扩张性）的随机根求解（或不动点）问题。
tldr: 本文提出双锚加速机制，在随机根求解中无需方差缩减或正则化，以迭代无关批大小实现$O(\epsilon^{-3})$复杂度，克服了锚点法的误差累积问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a dual-anchor acceleration mechanism that achieves O(ε^{-3}) complexity with iteration-independent batch sizes for stochastic root-finding, without variance reduction or regularization, overcoming error accumulation inherent in anchor-based methods.
